verdict.rationale: Steel is a browser API for AI agents, so an observe/plan primitive is a fair thing to ask of it, but the evidence shows no capability that previews candidate actions before the agent acts. What the pack does show earns no credit for this story. Page snapshots and markdown/screenshot tools are only building blocks. Human-in-the-loop debug URLs and agent traces are adjacent features: one is manual control, the other is a review after the run.
